title: Installation Jobs Compliance Rate Sheet: Lead-Safe, Permit and Approval Terms
content:
This compliance office rate sheet sets, for each installation method of **Installation Jobs**, the lead-safe work practice figures, whether a job is permitted and inspected by default with the permit administration fee figure, and who obtains homeowners-association or historic-district approval.

## Lead-safe work practices (EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting rule)

| Installation method | Lead-safe practices for homes built before (year) | Lead-safe fee per opening (USD) | Smallest lead-safe fee per job (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 1978 | 35.00 | 150.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 1978 | 45.00 | 175.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 1978 | 45.00 | 175.00 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 1978 | 55.00 | 195.00 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 1978 | 65.00 | 195.00 |
| Door System Installation | 1978 | 50.00 | 150.00 |

## Permits and approvals

| Installation method | Permitted and inspected by default | Permit administration fee, once per permitted job (USD) | Homeowners-association or historic-district approval obtained by the customer before scheduling |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | No | 0.00 | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation | Yes | 95.00 | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | Yes | 95.00 | Yes |
| Masonry Opening Installation | Yes | 125.00 | Yes |
| Bay and Bow Installation | Yes | 150.00 | Yes |
| Door System Installation | Yes | 95.00 | Yes |

## Notes to the sheet

1. The year column is a "before" boundary: a home built in 1977 is before 1978; a home built in 1978 is not.
2. A permit administration fee figure of 0.00 is shown where no permit is filed by default (Insert Pocket Installation).
3. The per-opening and per-job figures are the method's lead-safe figures; the per-job figure is the smallest lead-safe fee one job carries under that method.

## Reading the sheet (hypothetical example)

A hypothetical Bay and Bow Installation job is permitted and inspected by default with a permit administration fee figure of 150.00; its lead-safe figures are 65.00 per opening and 195.00 per job at the smallest.
